title: Sign-in providers
intro: Let people sign in with your own identity provider (OpenID Connect): Authentik, Keycloak, Microsoft Entra ID, Google and others. Local accounts keep working next to them.
none: No providers yet. People sign in with their Floorbit account, or with Discord if it is set up.
setSecret: The button appears once the server has the client secret in
linkedOnly: No role mapping: only accounts an admin linked on the Users page can sign in.
testOk: The provider answers and publishes {{keys}} signing key(s).
removeQuestion: Remove {{name}}? Its button goes away; accounts linked to it keep their other ways to sign in.
fallback: Local accounts always work, so an admin can still sign in when the identity provider is down.
name: Name
nameHint: Shown on the button: "Sign in with …"
issuerHint: Floorbit reads the endpoints and keys from its /.well-known/openid-configuration. https only.
secretHint: Never stored here. Set it on the server as an environment variable, or as a Docker secret file in the same name with _FILE:
callbackHint: Enter this in your identity provider:
claimHint: The claim with the person's groups or roles.
mappingHint: A claim value and the role it gives. With several matches the role with the most permissions wins. Without any rule, only linked accounts can sign in.
